method: OpenStreetMap way 905454906 (amenity=research_institute, name 'Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory', short_name 'JUNO', source 'maxar Premium'), 9 distinct vertices kept verbatim from an Overpass extract.
name: JUNO surface campus (OpenStreetMap outline)
notes: The outline's centroid is 1342 m from the published hall coordinate. The CDR (src:juno-cdr-arxiv-2015, Sec. 10.1.2) places the inclined-shaft entrance and the assembly/office/dormitory area at Shenghe Village, Jinji Town, with an inclined shaft 1,340 m long at 42.6 % slope (about 1.24 km horizontal run plus an 85 m interconnecting tunnel); arXiv:2104.02565 gives a 1266 m tunnel at 42.5 %. The 1.3 km separation is consistent with that, but no source states that this OSM polygon is the portal area, so the portal itself is not drawn.

summary.plain: The outline of the JUNO surface campus, about 1.3 km north-west of the underground hall, as traced in OpenStreetMap.
